Changed: The user rc is read-only to plugin management — the generated loader replaces the managed block (niubash#359 case A, 1.4.2). The control plane (`~/.niubash/plugins.toml` + `~/.niubash/sources/registry.toml`) now drives a derived activation plane: `niu plugin` verbs render and publish `~/.niubash/generated/plugins.niu` (deterministic, byte-stable when the manifest is unchanged, validate-then-atomic-publish so a failed generation never replaces the last good one and a concurrent reader never sees a missing file — the #304 invariant moves to the loader). The host sources that loader BEFORE the us

Double-execution guard for the migration window: the loader generation records the managed-block marker pairs it supersedes; at startup the host scans the rc read-only and keeps the loader OFF while any superseded block still executes (rather than run the plugin set twice), with a one-time hint naming `niu plugin migrate-rc`. Removing the old block by hand — the only removal there has ever been — turns the loader on. `niu doctor` reports the transition state read-only.

New verb `niu plugin migrate-rc [--diff]`: the read-only migration diagnostic. It scans the rc for legacy managed blocks (exact and hand-edited marker shapes, with line ranges and a begin-without-end malformed state reported, never fatal), publishes the candidate loader generation from the current manifest, records the superseded markers, and with `--diff` writes the suggested post-migration rc under `~/.niubash/candidates/`. It never modifies the rc — the removal is always the user's own edit.

Rollback switch: `NIU_PLUGIN_LOADER=off` (`off`/`false`/`0`/`no`) stops the host from loading the generated loader — plugins return to manual-source mode per the documented guidance. The switch only disables loading; it never writes anything, and unsetting it rolls forward.

Control-plane writers are atomic (design §4.4): `save_spec` (`plugins.toml`) and `write_source_registry` (`sources/registry.toml`) swap whole files through a same-dir temp + replace rename, so a concurrent reader never observes a truncate window.
Windows path contract: the bundled WinuxCmd coreutils own the shell tree —
they receive the shell's POSIX spellings verbatim and resolve them in-child —
while every other child, native or a foreign POSIX runtime such as MSYS2 or
Cygwin, always receives native Windows paths, with no per-child probe and no
`MSYS_NO_PATHCONV`-style switch (unixwin/niubash#346). This rides the
WinuxCmd shell-tree layer, so the bundled WinuxCmd pin must be bumped in the
same release.
Windows releases bundle niu-git 2.55.0.5 (`scripts/release/preinstall.json`).
niu-git moves to `layout: flat`: the payload lands under `opt\niugit` and
`mingw64\bin\git.exe` is mapped straight onto `usr\bin\git.exe`, so the `git`
on PATH *is* the git binary — no winuxcmd dispatch hop, no launcher, no MSYS
runtime and no perl in the process tree. `git --version` drops from 72–83 ms
to ~14 ms (Git Bash: 45–103 ms) and `git status` to ~23 ms. Needs WinuxCmd
1.1.9 or newer (the POSIX-unlink hardlink break, unixwin/WinuxCmd#1183);
the release pin already carries 1.1.10.
Added: `plugins::loader`: the generated-loader module — document format (banner, superseded-marker record, per-source sections byte-identical to the old block bodies), structural validation, atomic publish, the startup decision (opt-out switch → double-execution scan → load), the legacy-block scanner behind `migrate-rc`/doctor, and the one-time hint marker. Shell-face startup is a measured contract (`scripts/perf/shell-face-startup.py`):
execution-level `-c exit` timing for every installed face — the `niu.exe`
payload, the `winuxcmd\bin` / `winuxcmd\usr\bin` `bash.exe`/`sh.exe` links,
and the `C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe` convention slot — with a
verify-before-record rule (a face that cannot execute prints the failure
note, never a fast number), structural annotations (size, hardlink count,
same-file-as-payload), a `Measure-Command` cross-check mode, and a
deterministic `--check-links` gate: every declared face must be the same
file as the payload `niu.exe`. A measured-time-ratio gate was tried first
and rejected with data — shimmed faces measured 1.04–1.46x the payload
while healthy relinked faces measured 0.91–1.26x, overlapping intervals,
so no ratio separates the states without false kills (niubash#377 CR).

The installer sweeps retired shim shapes out of the PATH entry directory
(niubash#376 hygiene): `{app}\winuxcmd\bin` and `{app}\winuxcmd\usr\bin` are
cleared of `*.bak-*` / `*.old-*` / `*.niu-old-*` on install and uninstall —

(hardlinks only, `usr\bin` off `PATH`, declared entry set) is now documented

The factory prompt's git segment runs the user's own git instead of the
in-process libgit2 dependency: one bounded
`git status --porcelain=v2 --branch` inside a repository, and no spawn at
all outside one (a few `stat`s, where `__git_ps1` forks anyway). Fidelity
is the reason to switch — sparse checkouts, linked worktrees, submodules and
`safe.directory` refusals are answered by the git the user actually runs
(libgit2 silently dropped the branch segment on old-owner trees once) — and
the cost is unchanged in practice: measured p50 26 ms / max 37 ms per prompt
inside a repository, i.e. the bare git call and nothing more, against Git
Bash's `__git_ps1` 100-300 ms (three to five forks). Isolation rules, one
per incident: never through a shell (a missing git is an OS error, not
`command not found` noise), stdout captured and stderr discarded (git
warnings never reach the screen), `--no-optional-locks` +
`GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0` (never takes `index.lock`), `-c core.fsmonitor=false`
(never starts an fsmonitor daemon from a prompt), a 2 s timeout with the
child killed, and no `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` (measured +28 ms per call: it makes
Windows allocate a hidden console for every prompt; a console child inherits
ours and shows no window). This also drops the `git2`/libgit2 dependency:
~1.28 MB of the binary and 323 locked packages (libgit2-sys, url/idna/ICU,
cc, pkg-config, vcpkg, ...). Both niubash#145 startup invariants still pass
(`legacy_niu_plugins_rc_reaches_prompt`,
`legacy_framework_rc_reaches_prompt`): nothing is waited on before the first
paint, and the prompt-scoped child is reaped by the prompt itself. A
brand-new repository (unborn HEAD) now shows its branch, where libgit2's
`head()` errored and the segment vanished.
Fixed: A DSR-silent terminal no longer kills the shell, and TAB completion
commits (unixwin/niubash#373, the #355 follow-up). Interactive startup
used to anchor the prompt with a `ESC[6n` cursor-position query and ABORT
the line editor when it timed out: on a terminal that never answers
(dumb terminals, `script(1)` recordings, some serial/tmux links) every
startup paid a ~2.6 s stall, printed
"niubash: line editor error: The cursor position could not be read within
a normal duration", and exited before painting any prompt. The editor
(reedline 0.50 -> 0.52) now treats the query as advisory — the prompt
paints without a reply and later cycles stay interactive; Windows/ConPTY
is unaffected either way (conhost withholds the client at session attach
until the terminal answers, a terminal-side contract below niu, pinned by
the new `tests/issue373.rs` harness). File completion now commits
like command completion: `cat uniqfi<TAB>` splices the completed word
into the line (the unique match commits outright, the ambiguous set
commits its common prefix and still shows the grid) instead of leaving
the suffix as a menu preview that Enter executed unexpanded — and Enter
submits the line as typed (GNU accept-line), dismissing the grid, where
reedline 0.52's menu would have consumed the first Enter as an
acceptance. The dismissal rides only the completion TAB window: a
Ctrl+R history search's accepting Enter stays the bare event reedline's
search handler implements (a whole `Multiple` batch is dropped there —
unconditionally wrapping it turned the search's Enter into a dead key). Measured TTP on the ConPTY harness is unchanged (niu 3.14 s
vs GNU bash 3.26 s median, transport-floor dominated; internal startup
~70-140 ms — `scripts/perf/ttp-bench.py`).
dirname/basename: slash-shaped operands stay verbatim — `dirname /a/b`
reports `/a` instead of a drive spelling such as `A:`; the slash-drive
argument mask now covers the filesystem-blind string tools
(unixwin/niubash#346).

(`CompletionStyle::Column`, owner rulings 2026-10-12 + 2026-10-14):

implemented as a reedline `Menu` (`completion::gnu_menu`) so it renders

Architecture correction before release: the carapace-bin completion source
merged from #243 is removed from the shell core. No shell hardcodes a
third-party completion provider into its source — the provider belongs in
the rc data layer, integrating through the standard bash completion
protocol the shell already speaks (`complete` compspecs, `NIU_COMPDEFS`
compdef functions, `<cmd>.toml`/`<cmd>.bash` definition files). The native
completion layers are unchanged (embedded WinuxCmd applet TOMLs, bundle
definitions, user completion files); `niu setup` grows an opt-in (default
off) rc snippet for carapace-bin — the same block a bash user writes by
hand, guarded and a no-op until carapace-bin is installed — and a new
docs page documents the rc-based contract for any provider that speaks
the bash completion protocol (carapace is one example). Binary-level tests
pin the rc route: a `complete -W` compspec and a compdef hook sourced from
`~/.niubashrc` both serve Tab candidates, and a standard `.bash` completion
script serves flag candidates through the bash-import channel. Interactive
Tab resolution of `complete -F`/`-C` hook functions remains an engine
(rubash) follow-up, documented in the provider page. Zero compatibility
debt: no 1.4.0 tag ever carried the embedded source, and the `NIU_CARAPACE`
variable was never a released surface (niubash#243, niubash#187).
command-not-found no longer advertises package managers by default
(niubash#249): a typo like `win` prints only the GNU one-liner — the
unsolicited "package search hints" block naming winget/scoop/choco is
removed, and third-party managers are never recommended again. The
recipe/wpm install hints for exact, known tool names (`rg`, `awk`, …)
stay. An opt-in channel returns a wpm-only suggestion:
`niu config set command-not-found-hint wpm` (persisted in the new
`~/.niubash/config.toml`; `NIU_COMMAND_NOT_FOUND_HINT` overrides) — it
suggests one `wpm search --name '<word>'` line only for
high-confidence near-misses (dropping the word's last character hits an
installed command or a known package name), so pure typos stay quiet
even with the switch on. New `niu config get/list/set` subcommand surface
manages the file.

Installer disclosure (niubash#313): the "Create a desktop shortcut"
task is new in 1.4.x and default-checked. Silent installs and upgrades
(`/SILENT`, `/VERYSILENT`) never show the task page, and Inno has no
saved selection for a new task name — so a silent upgrade of a 1.3.x
machine runs the task with its default state and grows a desktop icon
(rewritten in place to the Windows Terminal form by the shortcut step)
without ever asking. Owner ruling: the behavior is intended; it is
disclosed here and in the installer source. Interactive installs keep
remembering an unchecked choice.
Added: Windows Terminal-form desktop/Start-menu shortcuts on Windows 10
(niubash#211, #290): Win10 has no default-terminal setting, so
direct-exe shortcuts used to be hosted by conhost. When a `wt.exe`
resolves (WindowsApps alias -> PATH -> App Paths registry) and the
Niubash WT profile is registered, generated shortcuts take the
`wt.exe -p Niubash` form; without WT the conhost baseline stays
unchanged. `niu --install-wt-shortcuts` (`--update-only`,
`--desktop|--start-menu`) is the standalone verb and the installer
handoff, and it only rewrites links that already exist, so a declined

invocations (#272): opt-in, so a chain of one-shot `niu -c` calls
behaves like one shell — the directory recorded in `<file>` is
restored before startup (before niu's own startup logic, relative

directory is recorded back after every one-shot exit path. Without
the flag, behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged.
`niu --encoded-command <base64>` (#271): agents and CI callers
get a quoting-free channel — an RFC 4648 payload (padding optional,
ASCII whitespace ignored, must decode to valid UTF-8) executes
through the same one-shot path as `-c`, with the same
`BASH_ENV`/`NIU_ENV` sourcing and `BASH_EXECUTION_STRING` contract.

can start with `/`.
Doctor timing advice (niubash#201): `niu doctor` now carries an advisory

(~10-30ms) while the builtin expands in microseconds with the GNU format

agreement with `date +%s`, live monotonic updates, and the speed gap.

Vi editing mode wired end-to-end (niubash#184): `set -o vi` / `set -o

`builtins/set.def:424 set_edit_mode` → `rl_variable_bind("editing-mode")`,
rebindkeymap applied immediately by readline `bind.c:2092 sv_editmode`).
The product re-reads the engine option flags at every prompt
(`Shell::refresh_edit_mode`), rebuilds the Reedline editor on a change,
and writes the winner back exclusively, so `set -o vi` → `set -o emacs` →

(GNU bash ships no built-in indicator). ESC enters normal mode through
reedline's built-in vi parser; normal-mode motions (`k` history recall,
`dd` line kill) are covered by ConPTY journeys.

Fixed: The self-update installer is SHA256-verified, fail-closed, and the
release ecosystem is pinned (niubash#311, niubash#312, PR #318):
every Windows setup.exe ships with a coreutils-style `.sha256` sidecar
(plus an aggregate `SHA256SUMS` for the whole release — both are
release assets, and the same digests feed the winget manifest).
`niu self-update` downloads the sidecar published beside the same
asset it fetched, hashes the installer, and aborts before launch on
any mismatch — or when the sidecar cannot be fetched at all (the
error points at the manual-download path). Release builds no longer
taste the live ecosystem: workflow dispatches require a pinned
WinuxCmd tag plus per-arch zip digests, tag pushes read the committed
`scripts/release/winuxcmd-pin.json`, and the wpm pre-install manifest
pins every package's artifact SHA-256 per arch (pin == index ==
shipped bytes; a pin failure keeps the loud fail-open warn-and-ship
path).
Plugin verbs can no longer hang forever on a dead origin, and a failed
add no longer strands its spec declaration (niubash#293, niubash#294,
niubash#295, niubash#296). Every git transport a plugin verb spawns —
`niu plugin add`/`sync`/`update`/`restore`/`distro import` — now runs
under a 120 s wall-clock budget (`--timeout <seconds>` on `add`/`sync`,
or `NIU_PLUGIN_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS`, overrides it per run; the rc
`--bootstrap` form keeps its tighter 3 s): at the budget the clone's
whole process tree is killed (no more orphan `git.exe` helpers after a
hand-killed niu) and the failure row names the timed-out origin. The
spawned git also carries the user's proxy environment explicitly
(`HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`ALL_PROXY`/`NO_PROXY`, each mirrored to
its case-variant, so an uppercase-only environment still reaches git's
case-sensitive transport). A sync stays per-source isolated: one
stalled origin costs its own budget and a failed row while the rest of
the spec reconciles. A declaration whose install just failed joins the
stranded population, so `niu plugin sync --prune` removes it in the
same run — and `niu plugin add` of a dead origin rolls its declaration
back on the bounded failure, so the target can be re-added instead of
deadlocking on "already declared".
The Windows paste-chunk detection no longer swallows the first Enter of
every line (niubash#284, a niubash#252 regression): whether a bare Enter
submits or opens a paste chunk is now decided structurally — by the LF
partner (`Enter + CONTROL`) queued right behind it, the console's shape
for a machine-fed CRLF line break — not by the 50 ms arrival-burst
heuristic. "Text + Enter" in one burst (fast human typing, ConPTY test
drivers, expect scripts, `send-keys`) submits on the first Enter again;
multi-line pastes keep buffering quietly until the user's own Enter
(0 mid-paste executions, niubash#202 contract unchanged). A typeahead
line queued behind a submitting Enter is pushed back and lands, in
order, at the next prompt. The TypeaheadGuard no longer double-injects
swept console input records: the sweeper's self-heal path drains the
buffer before writing it back, so a record can no longer be reinjected
twice (once by the self-heal, once by disarm; niubash#287).
A paste burst's trailing bare Enter now submits the buffered chunk
(niubash#308): a paste followed immediately by Enter — one write, the
Enter inside the burst window — used to be swallowed, and a second
Enter was needed. The same LF-partner lookahead that decides the
chunk-open Enter now runs in the pending branch: silence (or any
other queued key) behind the CR proves the chunk complete, and the
chunk flushes and submits in one batch on the first Enter.
Execution-level paste regressions pin empty-line fidelity across
every shape (niubash#291, PR #317).
The plugin trust gate now runs at runtime, not only at trust time
(niubash#297): `niu plugin sync` and `plugin list` re-verify every
trusted source against its lockfile pin, so a tree modified after
`trust` reads `drift` (never a lying `unchanged`) and
`degraded=true` with the drift reason in `--json` — the tree stops
contributing assets until it is repaired. sync records drifted ids in
`sources/drifted-sources.txt`, and the managed rc blocks carry a static
guard that prints the warning at every startup (the rc stays static

open, instead of failing halfway. 1.1.12 refused up front when it *thought* a
destination could not be replaced, but the probe it used — opening the name
with `DELETE` access — succeeds against a file another process has mapped as
its image, while the delete and the overwrite that follow both fail with
Access denied. On a real installation this meant `wpm install niugit --force`
still failed while git's `fsmonitor--daemon` held
`libexec/git-core/git.exe`, and it failed *after* the reconcile and the entry
links had run, leaving the package half-updated.
Destinations are now renamed aside (`<name>.wpm-old-<pid>`) before
anything is written: a rename is exactly what a mapped image permits, the
running process keeps its old bytes, and the operation is reversible. If a
destination cannot even be renamed, the ones already parked are put back and
the install refuses with the culprit and the processes running from it — so
an upgrade is either complete or untouched. Once the install commits, the
parked names are deleted; while the old process still holds them the name
stays, and `wpm clean` removes it later.
wpm: a superseded path the new version no longer maps is parked the same
way instead of aborting the upgrade when a live process holds it.
wpm: `wpm clean staging` and `wpm clean all` also remove parked
`.wpm-old-<pid>` names left by earlier installs.
Verified on a live installation with 28 `fsmonitor--daemon` processes holding
the payload: the forced upgrade succeeds, `usr/bin/git.exe` and `bin/git.exe`
both share the payload inode, and `.wpm/staging` is pruned.
wpm: an install is refused up front when a destination is held open by
a running program, instead of failing halfway through. A file held by another
process cannot be replaced on Windows at all — delete and overwrite both
return *Access denied* — so the old behaviour could leave a package
half-updated; an upgrade of niugit was observed with `opt/niugit` on the new
version while the PATH entry still ran the old one. WPM now probes every
destination before writing anything, lists the files and the programs running
from them, and leaves the installation exactly as it was. Close the listed
programs and retry.
wpm: flat-layout file mappings are copied from the package's payload
rather than the extraction directory, so a mapping that duplicates a path
already covered by a directory mapping no longer produces a second copy of
the package and a PATH entry pointing into `.wpm/staging` (the two
destinations now share one inode). The staging tree is pruned after a
successful install.
Added: wpm: every package command gets a PATH entry link at
`<root>/bin/<cmd>.exe` — a hardlink to the real binary (the payload under
`opt/<pkg>/` for shim packages, the mapped binary in `usr/bin/` for flat
ones), never a launcher, so nothing extra runs per invocation. The links are
recorded in the package receipt and kept in sync by install, update,
`wpm links rebuild` and uninstall.

Fixed: wpm: `wpm update winuxcmd` swaps the image by unlinking the old name
and moving the staged binary into place instead of overwriting a
running/mapped image in place. The in-place write fails with "being used by
another process" whenever any process holds the file (observed on a live
install, where the update silently kept the old version), and writing under
a mapped image is unsafe for the processes already running from it. The
in-place path remains the fallback when the unlink itself fails.
wpm: installing a package reconciles its own previous install first -
destinations the new artifact no longer maps are removed and, on a version
change, files inside still-mapped directories that the new payload dropped
are pruned. Before, a layout change left inert leftovers behind (the retired
shim launcher `opt\<pkg>\<cmd>.exe` after a move to `layout: flat`, or a
stale DLL in a PATH directory from older flat packaging). Only paths
recorded in the package's own receipt are touched, they must resolve inside
the root, and the winuxcmd image and the running executable are never
deleted.
wpm: `outdated` orders versions instead of comparing strings, so a stale
mirror advertising an older version no longer reports a
`update available: 2.55.0.5 -> 2.55.0.4` downgrade. The order is the
dotted-numeric core plus, when present, a Debian-style packaging revision
(`5.4.1-unixwin2` > `5.4.1-unixwin1` > `5.4.1`) - what a repackaged artifact
needs, since the upstream version stays and our rebuild gets a revision.
Vendor spellings (`9.5.0.0p1`, `r42`, ...) keep the conservative "any
difference is an update" rule.

Added: native_path: normalized API operands now resolve the shell tree — the bare
`/` and every path below the configured install root, `/tmp`, `/var/tmp`,
`/home` and the `/mnt/X` WSL drive form — and a shell-namespaced operand's
canonical result is re-expressed in the POSIX face, so `readlink -f` and
`realpath` agree with `pwd`. The executable-leaf open order (an existing
as-spelled path wins, else the `X.exe` sibling) keeps `test -f /usr/bin/seq`
and `head -1 /usr/bin/seq` consistent while `ls -d` keeps the operand
spelling. The layer is inert unless a shell root is configured, so standalone
WinuxCmd keeps its native dialect (unixwin/niubash#346).

Fixed: wpm: installing a payload file over an existing `usr\bin` command name
now breaks the old WinuxCmd multicall hardlink with POSIX-semantics unlink
instead of a plain `DeleteFileW`. Every `usr\bin` entry is a link to the
same on-disk image as the running `wpm.exe`/`winuxcmd.exe`, so the plain
delete self-locked and failed with `Access denied` ("failed to break
WinuxCmd hardlink"). Only `layout: flat` packages, whose payload maps the
real binary onto `usr\bin\<cmd>.exe`, ever reach this path — first hit by
`wpm install niugit --force` (unixwin/niu-git#8). The same POSIX unlink is
now used by the stale-link cleanup and alias-replacement paths, which had
the identical hazard.

Changed: wpm: shim payload resolution checks shallow per-package locations
(`<pkg>/<cmd>.exe`, plus `bin/`, `libexec/`, `lib/`, `sbin/`, `usr/bin/` at
depth 1-3, shallowest wins) before falling back to the bounded recursive
scan, so command-differs-from-package shims (`git` -> `niugit`, `cargo` ->
`rust`, `clang` -> `llvm`, `nu` -> `nushell`, `nvim` -> `neovim`) no longer
pay a whole-`opt/` tree walk on every invocation (~15k files). `time git`
through the shim 212 ms -> 77 ms; a prompt-style git hook batch
847 ms -> 291 ms; direct-hit shims (`python`, `curl`, `node`) are unchanged
(unixwin/niu-git#8).
Fixed: ls: `/` (also spelled `//`, `///`) resolves to the shell root named by
`__RUBASH_SHELL_ROOT`/`NIU_ROOT`/`WINUXSH_ROOT`/`RUBASH_ROOT` instead of
enumerating the drive root, independently of the current directory;
recursive listings keep the logical `/...` headers while lookups and entry
metadata go through the shell root (unixwin/niubash#346).

coreutils-style sections (File operations, Text processing, Shell
utilities, ...) with alphabetical entries and a discovery guide
(`winuxcmd <command> --help`, `winuxcmd help <command>`,
`winuxcmd --list-all`, `wpm search`); `winuxcmd --list-all` preserves the
flat alphabetical listing. When the system locale is non-English and its

fixed format, precision 0, no `--format`/`-w`, |operands| <= 2^52) emit

residual is Windows process spawn). The byte stream is unchanged — a
regression test pins all 588,895 bytes across several flush rounds

printer with sdiff (identical rows, `(`/`)` remainders, `/`/`\`

docs: the GNU coreutils compatibility records the one deliberate
Windows deviation around literal-glob operands — NTFS/Win32 forbid `*` in
file names, so `touch 'x*x'` reports the NTFS error where GNU creates the

and the derived `ls 'x*x'` miss is a consequence of GNU's own creation
succeeding; the touch test exemption is registered in
`DOCS/gnu-coreutils/touch.md` and `COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md` (#1143, #1167).
Fixed: spawn: every child-process launch (the xargs/`find -exec`/pipeline
spawn family) resolves through a shared GNU `execvp`-style resolver —
bare names search PATH only (no cwd or implicit System32 shadowing, so
`sort`/`find`/`tree`... pick the GNU-compatible binary the caller put on
PATH first) and POSIX PATH spellings (`/c/...`, `/cygdrive/c/...`,
`:`-separated entries) are split and converted before resolution
(owner-reported, #1169).

`/cygdrive/c/...`) now resolve through the same operand boundary as every

entries, and the `-files0-from` source operand all go through it (#1170).
tests: the grep junction recursion cases degrade to a SKIP on hosts
without symlink-creation privilege (error 1314) instead of failing, mirroring
the `*_or_skip` helper every other unit test file uses (#1168). New tput

capability, missing operand — leaves piped stdin untouched, the contract
GNU tput is known for (#1166).

localized messages work when `winuxcmd.exe` is invoked through a shim or
PATH entry outside the install directory (#1151).

that glob to nothing are treated as missing under `-c` (skipped) instead of
being created verbatim, matching GNU coreutils (#1152).
wpm: interaction-audit fixes (#1156). `wpm outdated` now anchors
installed versions on install receipts, so it keeps reporting a pending
update after `wpm index update` instead of flipping to "all up to date"
while old files are still on disk. `wpm install --json` prints one
machine-readable payload (statuses `installed`, `already_installed`,
`would_install`, `not_found`, `not_installable`, `preflight_failed`,
`download_failed`, `error`) with all human progress routed to stderr, and
`wpm index update --json` prints a matching payload. `wpm --help` now
documents the `install` `--force` reinstall/overwrite semantics. Verified
by measurement: piped `y`/`n` confirmation on `wpm uninstall` stdin (and

and locked destination files already fail loudly with exit 1 on both

`du src/` prints `src/` and `src/bin` (never `src//bin`), `du src//` prints

GNU coreutils (#1159).

resolve through the shared operand boundary — du used to reject them
with ENOENT while accepting `D:/...`, and sed could not read them as

uniformly applied); error messages and the `=`/`F` filename display

`user_sources` only — a `sources` array declared inside the cached index
file is no longer merged, so one poisoned fetch can no longer persistently

(`last_index_sha256`) and warns when the index content changes while being

trusted proxy with `--proxy`/environment variables (#1177).

after it is passed to the utility verbatim (POSIX xargs operand

关联数组元素写不再全量重渲染（#618，PR #650）：`m[k]=v` 每次写曾做三次 O(keys) 操作（镜像字符串克隆、解析 memo 的 Vec 深拷贝、全量重渲染），填充数组是 O(n²)，K=5000 时单次写比 GNU 慢 433 倍。现改为 O(1) 追加一段 `[k]=v`，预算触发规范渲染压缩重复段（均摊 O(1)，串长不超 2 倍规范长度）；读路径零改动（追加永不过期）。K=5000 单次写快 45 倍，与 GNU 差距 445x→9.9x，key 数涨 5000 倍单次写仅漂 1.14x。附带修好一个 O(n²) tokenizer（每段 collect 整个剩余输入，10001 段真解析 563ms→17.8ms 线性）。50 例 GNU 差分电池 50/50；全量 failure-set 门禁与 niubash 产品 A/B 零差异。

#798 判定面钉死：source 中 `exit 1` 语义与 spawn 失败 `$?` 与 GNU 等价：LibreSSL testenc.sh 沙箱形态下 `cat openssl.cnf >p` 先截断后失败 → `cmp` 比的是两个空文件 → `exit 1` 本就不可达，47-cipher 循环跑穿是正确行为（WSL GNU 5.3.0 同样整循环，stdout 100 行/stderr 201 行 rc 0 逐字节一致；同机 rubash 4.5s < msys bash 5.2 5.3s，CI HANG 是 2 核 runner 8 并发下 ~400 次 spawn 的体量问题）。真实失败形态（cmp 差）首个失败即整体 rc 1 退出、交互会话同终止。回归 `tests/issue798_testenc_exit_in_source_regressions.rs`（hermetic：cmp/rm 用函数替身，钉 spawn-fail 127、空重定向目标、循环+if 形的 exit 终止）。

算术下标补上 `set -u` 检查（写路径）（#639，PR #654）：`set -u; a[k]=v` 曾静默存储 rc 0。GNU 所有下标经 `evalexp → expr_streval` 统一设卡（`expr.c:1190-1216`）；写路径求值器补上与兄弟函数相同的 prologue，五处下游诊断在 flag 下静默， abort 走 FORCE_EOF 通道（`-c` 下 127、脚本 1），另用独立 cell 区分 DISCARD 以免状态错位。25 例差分电池 10/25→25/25；回归文件 `tests/issue639_nounset_subscript.rs`。

复合赋值 `[@]`/`[*]` 报整词拒绝而非算术错（#636，PR #656）：`a+=( [@]=q )` 曾报 `@: arithmetic syntax error`，GNU 在算术求值前整词拒绝（`arrayfunc.c:786-792`，`cannot assign to non-numeric index`）。两处 compound 臂加精确匹配 guard（不 abort，走 GNU break 语义：保留部分存储、eval 可包含）。15 例差分电池 4/15→14/15（剩 declare-abort 例归 #635）；回归文件 `tests/issue636_atstar_compound.rs`。

`eval` 包含赋值 DISCARD 跳转（#637，PR #657）：`eval 'a[-2]=q'` 曾结束整个脚本。GNU 在 eval 边界捕获 DISCARD（`evalstring.c:365,422-442`），eval 返回失败、调用者继续。新增 bad-subscript class marker，eval 边界精确吸收（算术/nounset 照常逃逸）；eval 内按行继续，返回末行状态。20 例差分电池 9/20→20/20；回归文件 `tests/issue637_eval_discard.rs`。

declare/local 越界负下标 abort 而非静默丢弃（#635，PR #658）：`declare -a a=( [-2]=q )` 曾打印 AFTER rc 0。builtin 解析器区分无头/越界，扫描中断并保留部分存储，报错词经 out-param 上浮到 Executor 层做 fatal 诊断+abort（复用 #637 原语实现 eval 包含）。20 例差分电池 6/20→20/20；回归文件 `tests/issue635_builtin_oob.rs`。`export`/`readonly` 的同类 abort  threading 记作后续。

prompt 渲染不再破坏读者的 `$?`/PIPESTATUS（#604）：交互驱动（niu 原生控制台通道，`expand_prompt_string_mut`）渲染 `PS1`/`PS2`/`PS0` 时，内嵌 `$(false)` 等命令替换的退出状态此前经赋值展开引擎的替换边界写入 `exit_code`，下一个命令的 `$?` 读到 1；GNU 的 prompt 渲染是读侧操作，从不动读者的状态（WSL GNU Bash 5.3.0 piped-`-i` 探针：`PS1='$(false)'` 渲染后 `echo $?` 仍打印渲染前的值）。修复：渲染通道快照并在收尾恢复 `$?` 与 PIPESTATUS——赋值 RHS 通道（`v=$(false)` → rc=1 的 POSIX 赋值退出规则）不受影响。附带 #604 的通道 parity 回归与相对性能上限测试（PS1 渲染路径 vs PROMPT_COMMAND 路径的中位耗时比值上限），并按 profile 数据澄清该 issue 的主刀：四主题 rr 成本为外部 spawn 数 × Windows spawn 地板（每次渲染 4-6 次 git spawn；裸 `std::process::Command` 对同一 git.exe 需 208.9ms，rubash 会话内 217.6ms），两条引擎通道执行
构建: 命令替换 pipeline-filter 死链删除（#710）：`command_substitution_pipeline_filter` 的 8 条 filter 臂（sort/sed/tr/head/grep/wc/tail/uniq）连同其唯一调用链——`command_substitution_pipeline_output`、`timed_command_substitution_inner` 的 `|` 臂、`command_substitution_pipeline_first_stage`、孤儿助手 `split_pipeline_words`/`echo_raw_output`——自 rubash#117 平凡性 gate 之后不可达：gate 字节白名单拒绝 `|`，能抵达 filter 的替换体不可能含管线；且该链还只住在 `time` 前缀快捷方式内，进一步收窄。运行时复核：入口探针在 producer×filter 电池（含反引号、嵌套 comsub、alias 注入 `|`、`cat`/generic 首段、`time` 前缀形）上零命中；阳性对照（gate 临时放行 `|`）全部探针命中并复现休眠特征（`$(…|wc)` 默认单列 `1`，而活跃路径是三列）。`$( … | … )` 的可观测行为本就由真执行器管线（pipeline_exec）与外部

sections: GNU Bash 5.3.0 兼容性大幅推进。83 套件 true-baseline 总差异从 3427 行降至 2072 行（−40%），零差套件从 31 增至 32。
新增: 登录 shell 启动链（#487，PR #489）：argv[0] 首字符 `-` 或 `-l`/`--login`（含 `-lc` 组合形态）置 login 标志后，Unix（`not(windows)` 门，覆盖 Linux 与 macOS）上登录 shell 依次 source /etc/profile → 首个存在的 ~/.bash_profile | ~/.bash_login | ~/.profile；非登录交互 shell 依次 source /etc/bash.bashrc（存在时）+ ~/.bashrc（--rcfile/--init-file 只替换个人 rc）；启动文件中 `exit` 终止 shell 且后续不执行（与 --rcfile 一致）。`--noprofile`/`--norc` 分别抑制对应分支。Windows 无真实登录概念：-l/--login 接受且行为与现状完全一致（不读任何链文件）。链顺序/fallback 以注入式存在性检查做单元测试；Linux/macOS 端到端由 CI 对应 job 验证。

真 readline REPL（#419 readline 腿，PR #482）：裸 `rubash.exe` 真控制台交互补齐 readline 行编辑——此前控制台分支 stdin 留在 cooked 行输入模式，编辑由 conhost 代管，shell 历史（↑/↓、C-p/C-n）、行内光标移动（C-a/C-e/←/→）与 C-r 反向搜索全部失效。新增 `RawConsole`（`src/console_readline.rs`）：提示符与接受行之间切 raw 模式，按键逐事件翻译成引擎编辑分派器已有的字符流，编辑行每键重绘（raw 模式下终端不再回显）；命令执行前恢复 cooked 模式，子进程仍见正常行纪律控制台。编辑分派器从读循环抽出为 `apply_edit_char`，cooked 字节流路径（#434 桥接语义不变）与 raw 控制台路径共享同一套绑定；PS1/PS2（含 `--rcfile`）渲染共用。补全（Tab）与 i-search 的 raw 态渲染为后续分层。

`--version` 构建元数据（#488，PR #490）：GNU license 块（保持逐字节不变）之后追加 `build: <git-hash> (<profile>)`——build.rs 编译期捕获 `git rev-parse --short HEAD`（git 不可用时回退 unknown，发布打包可 `RUBASH_BUILD_HASH` 钉值），profile 为 debug/release；Windows 附加一行 persona 说明：原生 Windows 构建、无 MSYS runtime，`*-pc-msys` MACHTYPE 不应读作 MSYS2/Cygwin bash 移植。
GNU `cp` 移植：-r/-n/-i/-v/-p/-u/-t、递归、缓冲 stderr；`/bin/echo` 与 `/usr/bin/echo` 路由到缓冲 builtin 通道。
`history -d start-end` 范围删除（GNU 5.3 特性）。
`stty` builtin (PR #567): console mode queries and mutations without leaving the shell (`stty size`, `stty raw -echo`, ...), complementing the `read` fd-semantics work below.

`bash --help` / `sh --help` fork to the GNU usage contract (#585, PR #596): the help screen follows the invocation name and prints GNU's usage contract — option table and exit status — instead of a product-generic help screen.
修复: 命令替换的退出状态在展开期内即刻成为 `$?`（#485，PR #491/#494）：GNU 在父壳回收替换子进程时就把其状态写入 last_command_exit_value，同一命令行内后置的 `$?`（后续词、同词后缀片段、同一简单命令的后续赋值 RHS）都看得见，成功的替换同样覆盖（`echo "$(cd nope && pwd)" $?` 报 1、`false; echo "$(true) $?"` 报 0、`v="$(exit 3)$?"` 得 v=3 且 rc=3），命令自身执行后照常覆盖。此前 rubash 只把状态记进 `last_command_substitution_status` 单元、仅在空词/赋值收尾时提升，词展开路径上丢失该时序。修复：AST/function 替换与 `&self` 包装器三个回落点的父侧回收处直接写 `exit_code`（fork 模型保存/恢复中的 `saved_exit_code` 不再回退状态），整词引号 `"$( )"` 快路径发布同一状态；反引号嵌词从遗留 `&self` 展开器改道可变嵌入 walker（与 `$()` 词共用生产路径与同一批提升点）。`local` 屏蔽赋值状态、`set -e` 下替换赋值失败中止（rc=1）而词内替换失败不中止（echo 自身 rc=0）均保持 GNU 一致。

函数定义与花括号组的同行 `#` 尾注释不再解析失败（#118）：`f() { # note`、`f() { echo x; } # note`、`{ echo x; } # note`、`function f { … } # note`、TAB/空注释等形态此前被 lexer 把注释切进花括号组 token（`{ # note`），parser 因 `function_command.rs` 的 `value.trim() == "{"` 判定失败而回落成 `syntax error near unexpected token `('`。`skip_brace` 现在汇报配对 `}` 是否命中以及组内顶层注释起点，scanner 只把注释之前的文本作为 token 并把位置回退到注释处；`brace_close_can_end_compact_group` 也把 `}` 之后的行内 `#` 视为组结束。另修正 `skip_brace` 的 `comment_start` 初值，`f() {#note` 仍按 GNU 报语法错误而非静默接受。
`set -u` 下算术展开不再把已赋值变量判为 unbound（#67）：nounset 扫描器去掉了无法识别错误 token 时的合成 "syntax error in expression" 回退，并跳过赋值左值（`for ((i=0; i<n; i++))` 的 init/update 不再报 `i` unbound）。
`set -u` 下算术展开的 unbound 错误与普通参数展开对齐：直接上下文中终止脚本，命令替换与管道段内只终止该子上下文（GNU expr.c expr_streval 的 FORCE_EOF 语义），并消除了随后把展开文本当命令执行的 `command not found` 级联。
管道中未加引号变量作命令字现在按 IFS 分词（#68）：`v="echo hi there"; $v | cat` 以 `echo` 为命令名、`hi there` 为参数执行，管道任意段、子 shell 与进程替换内一致。
命令替换内的 `eval` 恢复完整重解析语义（#69）：`x=$(eval "echo hi")` 得到 `hi`；移除把 `eval ` 前缀剥掉后当普通命令执行的捷径，`$(eval "$cmd" | sort)` 等真实脚本形态正常工作。
dbg-support 全族归零（635→0）：AND-列表双触发（execute_cmd.c 无 connection 节点火点）、source-scope trap 继承（source.def:208-216）、非行首 `{` 回归普通词法、for 每迭代行号重置。
rsh 全族归零（194→0）：`set +o restricted` 静默解除修复（set 快速路径跳过 GNU 拒绝检查）、set +r 文案/退出码、BASH_CMDS 赋值守卫、hash -p、管线成员斜杠拒绝、受限只读集、argv0 rbash 自动受限。
invocation 全族归零（14→0）：BASH_ARGV0 环境导入 $0/shell_name、login-shell argv0、长选项表、-o/-O 启动期报错 prolog、--pretty-print。
trap 归零（3→0）：ERR action $LINENO 绑失败命令行、SIGCHLD 通知排队重放、后台子进程剥离继承 trap 表、traced 函数 DEBUG 行号用 body_open_line。
func 全族归零（58→0）：POSIX funcname 规则、AST printer 移植、special-builtin 优先级。
complete 全族归零（115→0）：多操作数 compspec 注册（`complete -F f c1 c2` 双双生效）。
history 改善（190→127）：HISTIGNORE harness 修复、fc -s 语义对齐、命令替换内 fc/session 历史路由（`history -d start-end` 范围删除见新增）。
globstar 改善（182→101）：非相邻多个 `` 重复发射修复、相邻 `` 折叠后零深度目录尾斜杠。
array/assoc 改善（444+358→246+242）：复合赋值引号分组四层修复（解析器 RAW 合并、declare 操作数收集器、Word 臂原子复合、执行器逐字守卫）、元素赋值词边界、嵌套引号 patsub 逐元素替换。
unicode 修复：printf 和 ANSI-C 引号中 `\u`/`\U` 部分读取保留、精确十六进制位数要求。
locale 子系统：从 feat/locale-subsystem 合入，setlocale 警告、MB_STRLEN 长度。
comsub/pipeline：pathname-expand 替换、管线 word list、assoc hash order 共享 join。
assignment：全单引号 RHS 为字面数据、元素赋值词永不分词、转义引号内下标为数据。
nameref：无值 nameref 接受有效目标赋值。
SIGPIPE 语义：管道上游写端遭遇 broken pipe 不再中止解释器，`yes | head` 等流式管线行为与 GNU 一致（#455）。
输入规范化（粘贴语义）：桥接层送达的交互式输入行在进入引擎前规范化 C0 控制字节（#458）——终端粘贴携带的 NUL/控制字节不再以未定义方式进入词法。

source 边界的语法错误不再终止会话/脚本（#451，PR #481）：sourced 文件的语法错误按普通失败中止剩余文本（GNU evalstring.c 语义）——交互会话报错后继续读下一条，非交互脚本继续执行后续命令；此前中止被误分类为 reader exit jump，交互 shell 在诊断后立即结束（ConPTY 下表现为 source 后首条命令永不执行），非交互脚本以 rc 2 中止。
PS1 `\[`/`\]` 忽略标记在所有渲染路径剥离（#431，PR #480）：oh-my-bash inretio / bash-it 主题形状下不再把标记渲染为字面文本或泄漏 raw `\x01`/`\x02` 字节；`${var@P}` 提示符变换同步剥离；真实 ESC 颜色序列与光标定位几何不受影响。
赋值前缀 + 子 shell 的 GNU 形态（审计语料 #452 集群1，PR #453）。
`complete -F` 接受带连字符的函数名（#427，PR #454）。
复合体内 `]]` / `(( ))` 之后无终止符的 then/do 被接受（#460，PR #475）。
函数定义名含未引号 `$( )` 被接受（#462，PR #476）。
`=~` 正则词片段永远是词数据，不再被误判为保留字（#461，PR #473）。
嵌套 keyword-form 函数体计入组 opener 追踪，不再提前 EOF（#465，PR #472）。
词附着的多行进程替换体跨行 join（#463，PR #483）。
词首数据 raw ESC 字节（如单引号首字符）不再被吞（niubash#200，PR #474）。
ERR trap 不再对词/赋值展开错误触发（PR #467）。
Unix 上进程替换 fd 作为外部命令参数传递（PR #468）。
coproc 子进程继承父函数表快照，DEBUG trap 函数可解析（#441，PR #469）。
引号整词默认展开保持单一复合元素（PR #466）。

Pipeline members now honor shell functions — `date(){ ...; }; date | cat` runs the function, `echo(){ printf ...; }; echo hi | cat` shadows the builtin: two dispatch sites classified a pipeline stage before any function lookup, where GNU resolves functions before the PATH search in every stage (#587, PR #594).

A `PATH=` assignment prefix owns command resolution for its own command — `PATH=/opt/bin:$PATH git status` resolves `git` through the new PATH within that same simple command, including the pipeline and concurrent fast-path stages (#588, PR #594).

`cat`/`mkdir`/`touch`/`cp`/`rm`/`rmdir` stop re-expanding already-expanded argv (P0 pair) — `v='*.txt'; cat $v` silently read the wrong file and the mkdir/touch/cp/rm/rmdir family created or removed wrong paths; the builtins no longer re-run expansion over words the shell already expanded (#511, PR #552; #555, PR #558).

`$PWD`/`pwd` render the POSIX persona form unconditionally — the native-drive-style hatch is retired; it starved nvm's find_up loop, and native drive spelling now survives only at the Win32 spawn boundary per the path contract (#537, PR #556).
GNU semantics waves (each batch issue-locked and WSL-verified against GNU 5.3.0):
Wave 1 (PR #561): trap `exit` unwind, pipeline redirect rejection, nameref unbound gating, brace-expansion shape validation, redirect `set -u`, arithmetic latch (#524 #525 #529 #532 #535 #536).
Wave 2a (PR #560): SIGQUIT ignored in non-interactive shells, `-s` argument scan order, readonly attribute direction, `declare -na` structure wins, ERR single-fire guard.
Wave 2c (PR #573): RANDOM reseed on `declare -i`, heredoc-max fatal ordered before the unclosed-substitution scan, export/array/dynamic-variable/encoding semantics (#533 #534 #538-#543).
Wave 3 (PR #569): xtrace quote fidelity, redirect message rendering, `caller` frame limits, ERR trap function-entry, extdebug DEBUG-skip sites, `kill` signal names (#517-#522, #550).
Wave 4a (PR #576): redirect ambiguity gate, backtick diagnostic window, command-position paren, compgen tilde expansion (#514-#516, #523).
Wave 4b (PR #578): `$[ ]` EOF scan, `declare -aA`, procsub fd window, trap listing/DEBUG freeze, `bash -o` listing, jobs/alias parameter semantics (#543-#547, #549).

`read` console/fd semantics — empty-line exit status, fd 0 file-loop ownership, carrier-byte domain normalization, dup-stdin console reads, fractional `-t` deadlines, and the dup-fd ladder behave like GNU (#275-#282, PR #567).

`-s` stdin-script reads on demand through the canonical library driver — the parser consumes stdin one command at a time like GNU's non-seekable stream, so a `$(exec cat)`/`read`/top-level `exec cat` consumer sees exactly the bytes after the last submitted command and the unconsumed tail never executes as code (the `curl | bash -s` install-script hazard). The driver moved into `script_driver::run_stdin_script`, so embedding hosts get the same contract instead of slurping (#586, PR #593). Related: an exec'd child keeps the shell's stdin channel in every context (#575, PR #583).

CLI entry-shape semantics — POSIX special-builtin/assignment fatals map per entry shape (`-c` exits 127 like GNU `run_one_command`, scripts/stdin keep 1, subshell-contained stays 1); the shim forwards the bash/rbash invocation faces so `$0` reports the invoked name (and `sh`/`ash` keep the POSIX-mode contract) (#589 #590 #591, PR #598; #504).
`eval` EOF-shape probe is comment-aware — restores the modernish init battery (the #318 `unclosed_comsub_eof_shape` regression) (#282, PR #572).
Multiline `[[ ]]` with folded `(( ))` continuations parse like GNU, the `bind -v`/inputrc engine surface is honored, and the #433 rc regression ledger is pinned (PR #571).
Arithmetic-for sections evaluate the verbatim `(( ))` capture and carrier bytes never reach eval-error echoes (#548, PR #584).
Compound redirection failures reach the ERR trap again (the body-exemption gate was type-blind, PR #557), and the redirect expansion-error verdict propagates on the function fast path (PR #579).
P1 semantic batch — errexit body adjudication, stdin parse-error status, printf write-failure status, dirstack `EX_USAGE` (PR #553).
POSIX-mode coverage audit completed — 42/75 audited GNU posix-mode behaviors implemented: fatal assignment families, redirect no-split, `time` fd-2 routing, trap usage exits (PR #559).

Diagnostic fidelity — the C-family message formats match GNU: stdin line offsets, dolbrace scanning, PST_REGEXP two-stage EOF, outermost unclosed-block line naming, write-error prefix, and the `[[ =~` two-part diagnostic (#551, PR #563); a top-level unclosed procsub continues to the next line and `[ (` is reported as a diagnostic token (#564 #565, PR #577).

Windows path contract — POSIX drive-form operand pre-translation now covers every non-shell-wrapped child class with context/position/existence invariance: `/d/...` operands work the same inside loops, subshells, functions, pipelines and command substitution, for to-be-created targets and flag values, while data operands (grep/sed/awk patterns, `basename`/`dirname`) stay verbatim (#592, PR #600); `/mnt/c` is retired from the verbatim loop per the #568 adjudication (PR #574); bare drive-root POSIX forms are accepted (#566, PR #577).
回归钉子（无用户可见行为变化）：sourced `exit N` 终止语义（PR #457）、函数定义花括号行 token 语义（PR #459）、#424 重定向目标拒绝与 procsub 输入侧（PR #464）。
性能: 性能三连（#437/#281/#242）与 bats-core 热点（#375）推进：

#281 增量 reader 收官（PR #486，closes #281）：续行扫描 admission-gate + 物理行二分戳、零拷贝参数体视图、逐行 batch-tokenizer 停靠（GNU read_token 流式模型），以及 fold 完成趟的 opener-state checkpoint——fold 趟只需支付组自身文本，不再从字节 0 重新 lex 整个累积缓冲（nvm 形状 4281 次全量趟中 19 次大重扫的 270 KB 归零）。
#437 热点：算术循环 per-command boundary O(1) 化（数组追加与算术循环 micro-benchmark 报告的执行热点）。
#242 执行器热路径（部分）：named-event catch_flag 信号轮询、单遍 `${}` 算子索引 + 直接 simple-glob 匹配 + 算术快照容量、walker `${}` 臂 inline fragment 解析与模式快路径、allocation-free shopt 咨询、字面词快路径、comsub-scan O(n²) 修复等。
#375 第一刀（部分）：`$(cd X && pwd)` 命令替换路径解析单句柄化——一次 CreateFileW 同时取目录属性 + 物理路径（PR #484）；`$(cd && pwd)×5000` 878→779 ms（−11%），bats_debug_trap 形状 −8%，输出逐位等价。
perf-suite：专用基准 harness 与首个基线（24 probes，rubash vs WSL GNU 5.3.0）。
Lexer construction wins（rubash#241，PR #554）: fold-before-push moves, gated leading_ws capture, and inline TokStr strings — parse throughput up under alias-correct ground truth.
Executor dispatch floor（rubash#375，PR #562）: shape-only cd/pwd command-substitution admission and a DEBUG-trap parse-once cache retire the handle-table scale myth.
Hot-path construction-only wins（rubash#242，PR #501）: test argv zero-copy, gated fd marks, single word materialization, copy-on-write IFS strip, cached debug switches.
平台: Android 目标：aarch64/armv7 android 目标可针对 bionic 编译（#456，`sa_restorer` 平台门修正）；kill/trap 信号表在 android 上同样编译 Linux 编号的 1..31 槽位（bionic 与 Linux 内核编号逐值一致）——此前 `kill -l 17` 在 android 上输出为空、`trap -l` 列出 bionic 不用的 BSD 名；RT 字面量块保持 glibc 契约的 Linux 专属（PR #492）。
平台门全量审计（PR #492）：src/ 下 511 处平台 cfg 盘点分类；确认无「漏 macOS 腿」同类问题，真 Linux 专属门（RT 34..64 字面量、`sa_restorer` 等）保留。
OpenHarmony / musl：`ulimit` 针对 musl 与 OpenHarmony libc 编译修复（PR #449）。
信号编号统一：rubash 全表从 BSD/Cygwin 风格切换到 Linux 表（USR1=10、CHLD=17、RTMIN=34），与 GNU 5.3.0 WSL 契约一致；kill -l/trap -l 输出逐字节对齐。
Residual Windows assumptions are gated outside `cfg(windows)` so non-Windows builds stay honest (PR #499).
构建: crates.io 打包瘦身：发布包不再携带 `tests/` 与 `third_party/`（参考源码与测试语料，仅本地开发/CI 需要），包内容 2053 个文件 / 15.6 MB → 400 个文件 / 8.9 MB，回到 crates.io 10 MiB 上限之内；`exclude` 同步移除失效的 `!third_party/bash/tests/*.right` 反规则。功能与构建不受影响（`cargo publish --dry-run` 验证通过）。

Internal: twelve ghost module skeletons that never entered the compile tree are removed (PR #597); stale regression snapshots are re-baselined with an airtight snapshot env and a CI golden-refresh artifact (PR #496).
文档: 重写 README.md 和 README.zh-CN.md：数据驱动的兼容性展示、近期修复表、架构概览；其后一次事实保持的风格微调（PR #495）。
更新 COMPATIBILITY-STATUS.md：2026-09-11 全量 true-baseline 重跑结果、总体结论刷新。

README restructured again, evidence-first, with the cross-platform identity (EN+zh) (PR #500); the three boundary invariants — native core, POSIX forms, verbatim fidelity — are codified as contract tests plus a windows-path-contract document and proxy-driver guide (PR #570).
Platform gap documented: foreign children cannot receive exec-established numbered fds (#378, PR #580).

sections: 本版本将项目版本、兼容性证据和近期 Bash 语义修复同步到当前源码状态。
修复: 修正关联数组算术下标的引号处理；带引号的 `$()` 和算术下标不再被错误地预展开。
改进数组元素下标诊断，对空、`*` 和负下标报告与 Bash 一致的错误，同时保留参数展开的非致命行为。
修正参数展开扫描器对单引号内 `}` 的处理，并拒绝 Bash 不支持的空格包围命令替换形式。
修正算术条件错误 token 的渲染，以及 `enable -d` 无效 builtin 的使用状态和退出码。
保留进程替换、coproc、printf 溢出和 extglob 解析等近期修复的回归覆盖。
alias 展开为 `if ...; then`、`while ...; do`、`for ...; do` 等复合语句前缀时，会继续拼接到匹配的 `fi`/`done` 后重解析执行，补齐更接近 Bash 的 parser-level alias 行为。
赋值 RHS 紧邻 `<(...)` 进程替换时会作为赋值值解析并物化为可读路径，补齐 `p=<(cmd); cat "$p"` 这类 Bash 语法框架。
赋值 RHS 中的 `>(...)` 输出进程替换会登记为可写路径，并在后续重定向写入该路径后执行替换命令。
`[[ -e <(...) ]]`、`[[ -p >(...) ]]` 等条件文件测试会识别进程替换操作数的 pipe/fd 形状，补齐条件命令中的进程替换文件测试框架。
`for`/`select` 词列表中的 `<(...)`/`>(...)` 会先物化为可读/可写路径，再作为循环变量值使用。
`case` 匹配词中的 `<(...)`/`>(...)` 会先物化为路径，再参与 pattern 匹配。
同一 word 中混合 `$((...))`/`$[...]` 算术展开和参数展开时，按 Bash 的从左到右顺序保留自增等副作用。
`test -v` 与 `[[ -v ... ]]` 会识别 `RANDOM`、`SECONDS`、`BASH_COMMAND` 等动态 Bash 参数的已设置状态。
Windows/Git Bash 环境下 `test -O`、`test -G` 与 `[[ -O/-G path ]]` 对当前用户创建的现有路径返回成功，补齐所有权条件 unary 的跨平台框架。
`case` pattern 中被引号保护的 `*`、`?`、`[` 等 glob 元字符会按字面量匹配，变量在双引号 pattern 中展开后也保持字面匹配语义。
关联数组 key 含 `]` 时会在内部存储和 `declare -p` 输出中强制加引号，避免 `declare -A a=([x] one)` 这类交替 key/value 语法把字面 key `"[x]"` 误解析为下标 `x`。
alias 引入复合语句前缀时，匹配 `fi`/`done`/`esac` 会按嵌套复合语句深度处理，避免内层 `if` 或循环提前截断外层 alias 语句。
alias 引入 `time` 前缀并计时复合命令时，同样按嵌套深度收集被计时的 `if`/循环主体，避免内层结束词提前截断 `time` 语句。
alias 引入 `case` 时，case clause body 边界会跳过内层 `case ... esac`，避免内层 `;;`/`esac` 提前截断外层 clause。
alias 值提供 `function name` 前缀、函数体由后续 `if` 或循环复合命令提供时，会继续收集到匹配结束词后重解析为函数定义。
输出方向进程替换作为普通参数传给管道外部命令阶段或函数调用时，会物化为可写路径，并在阶段/函数结束后执行替换命令。
管道中的复合命令和函数阶段改为子 shell 风格执行，避免 `cd`、函数定义和算术赋值等状态泄漏到外层 shell。
`builtin` 命令统一走完整内建分发表，避免无重定向调用时漏掉 `let`、`read`、`mapfile`、job control 等已接入内建命令。
`shopt -s lastpipe` 开启后，管道最后一段可在当前 shell 执行，使 `read` 和 `while read` 等 final stage 状态更新保留到外层。
`coproc` 默认管道的父子端接线修正，并将 coproc 子进程纳入 `wait` 可识别的作业表，避免 brace body 在 Windows 上出现 stdio 访问错误。
反引号命令替换外部的转义反引号会保留为字面量，反引号命令替换内部的转义反引号分隔符可用于嵌套命令替换。
命令替换内部的简单 word splitting 会将嵌套 `$()` 保持为同一个 word，避免 `$(echo $(echo nested))` 被内部空格拆碎。
`printf -v` 支持将格式化结果写入 indexed array 和 associative array 的元素目标。
`printf -v arr[subscript]` 的 indexed array 目标会按 Bash 算术规则解析 subscript，并支持已有数组的负下标。
`compgen -W` 支持从 wordlist 生成匹配候选，并接入 `-P`/`-S` 前后缀和无匹配返回状态。
`compgen -V varname` 支持将生成的候选写入 indexed array 变量而不是输出到 stdout。
`compgen -A builtin` 和 `compgen -A keyword` 会生成内建命令/保留字候选，并支持 prefix 过滤和 `-P`/`-S` 包装。
`compgen -b` 和 `compgen -k` 会分别按 Bash 的短 action 形式生成内建命令与保留字候选。
`compgen -A signal` 会复用当前 `trap`/`kill` 支持的信号名称表生成候选。
`compgen -A shopt` 和 `compgen -A setopt` 会复用当前支持的 `shopt` / `set -o` 名称表生成候选。
`compgen -G` 会展开 glob pattern 生成路径候选，并支持 `-P`/`-S` 包装和无匹配状态。
`compgen -X` 会过滤已生成候选，支持 `!pattern` 反向过滤，并保留 Bash 的候选生成状态语义。
`compgen -d` 和 `compgen -A directory` 会从文件系统生成目录候选，并支持 prefix 过滤、`-P`/`-S` 包装和 `-X` 过滤。
`compgen -f` 和 `compgen -A file` 会从文件系统生成文件名候选，包含普通文件和目录，并支持现有候选过滤与包装流程。
`compgen -A helptopic` 会复用 `help` 主题表生成帮助主题候选。
`compgen -A enabled` 会生成当前支持且未被禁用的启用内建命令候选。
`compgen -A disabled` 会基于 `enable -n` 状态生成禁用内建命令候选。
`compgen -j` 和 `compgen -A job` 会基于当前后台 job 表生成 job 命令候选。
`compgen -A running` 会基于当前后台 job 表生成运行中 job 命令候选。
`compgen -A stopped` 接入停止状态 job 候选框架，当前无 stopped job 状态时保持空成功。
`compgen -A hostname` 会基于当前 shell 的 `HOSTNAME`/`COMPUTERNAME` 生成主机名候选。
`compgen -A binding` 会基于 GNU Readline 默认函数名表生成 binding 候选。
`compgen -u` 和 `compgen -A user` 会基于当前 shell 的 `USER`/`LOGNAME`/`USERNAME` 生成用户候选。
`compgen -g` 和 `compgen -A group` 会基于当前 shell 的 `GROUP`/`GROUPNAME`/`USERDOMAIN` 生成用户组候选。
`compgen -s` 和 `compgen -A service` 会基于当前 shell 的 `SERVICE`/`SERVICENAME` 服务名状态生成服务候选。
`compgen -v` 和 `compgen -A variable` 会基于当前 shell 变量表生成变量名候选。
`compgen -a` 和 `compgen -A alias` 会基于当前 shell alias 表生成别名候选。
`compgen -A function` 会基于当前 shell 函数表生成函数名候选。
`compgen -c` 和 `compgen -A command` 会合并内建命令、保留字、alias、函数和 `PATH` 文件生成命令名候选。
`compgen -A arrayvar` 会基于当前 shell 的 indexed/associative array 标记生成数组变量候选。
`compgen -e` 和 `compgen -A export` 会基于当前 shell 的 exported 变量标记生成导出变量候选。
`compgen -A readonly` 会基于当前 shell 的 readonly 变量标记生成只读变量候选。

Host compatibility: the `git` prompt segment (`[segments.git] id = "vcs"`
in `prompts/segments.toml`) now resolves to niubash's native
`SegmentId::Vcs` as of niubash 1.4.1 — branch / `branch*` / short SHA,
themed `[git_clean]` cyan / `[git_dirty]` yellow, rendered in-process with
zero child git processes. No bundle format change: every shipped preset
already carries the segment (the `lean` preset is the documented showcase).
Renamed the bundle from `oh-my-winuxsh` to `oh-my-niu` to match the
niubash 1.0.0 brand. Installed `~/.oh-my-winuxsh` directories keep
working: niubash discovers the pre-rename layout as a fallback.

`niubash:` (`niubash:plugin-bundle@0.1.0`, `niubash:plugin@0.1.0`,

environment prefix (`NIU_PLUGINS`, `NIU_THEME`, `NIU_THEME_PLUGIN`)
